meta.title: Group
meta.lead: Stack forms elements and buttons horizontally with `role="group"` and  `role="search"`.

blocks.md: `role="group"` is used to stack children horizontally.
When used with the `<form>` tag, the group is `width: 100%;`.
Unlike `.grid` (see [Grid](https://picocss.com/docs/grid)), columns are not collapsed on mobile devices.

blocks.label: Form group example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Form group example" class="component"><form><fieldset role="group"><input autocomplete="email" name="email" placeholder="Enter your email" type="email"/><input type="submit" value="Subscribe"/></fieldset></form></article>
blocks.code:
<form>
  <fieldset role="group">
    <input name="email" type="email" placeholder="Enter your email" autocomplete="email" />
    <input type="submit" value="Subscribe" />
  </fieldset>
</form>

blocks.md: This component is mainly designed for form elements and buttons. It brings a `:focus` style to the group depending on whether the focused child is an `<input>` or a `<button>`.
The group `:focus` style relies on the `:has()` CSS selector. When `:has()` is not supported the children have their regular `:focus` style.

blocks.label: Form group example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Form group example" class="component"><form><fieldset role="group"><input autocomplete="email" name="email" placeholder="Email" type="email"/><input autocomplete="current-password" name="password" placeholder="Password" type="password"/><input type="submit" value="Log in"/></fieldset></form></article>
blocks.code:
<form>
  <fieldset role="group">
    <input name="email" type="email" placeholder="Email" autocomplete="email" />
    <input name="password" type="password" placeholder="Password" />
    <input type="submit" value="Log in" />
  </fieldset>
</form>

blocks.md: `role="search"` also stacks children horizontally and brings a special style, consistent with `<input type="search">` (see [Search input](https://picocss.com/docs/forms/input#search)).

blocks.label: Searcgh group example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Searcgh group example" class="component"><form role="search"><input name="search" placeholder="Search" type="search"/><input type="submit" value="Search"/></form></article>
blocks.code:
<form role="search">
  <input name="search" type="search" placeholder="Search" />
  <input type="submit" value="Search" />
</form>

blocks.md: `role="group"` is also useful for grouping a series of buttons.
